Hi Marcus,

Quick one from our side — during the 30-day pilot we exceeded the reserved compute by about $14,800. We agreed on a promotional top-up when we signed the pilot, but our procurement team needs a formal credit memo or an invoice offset to reconcile the February bill.

- Issue a credit memo for the $14,800 and apply it to our account, or
- Apply an invoice offset against the upcoming March invoice, with a clear reference in the ledger so our AP can net it out.

We also need a short description that we can attach to our internal PO (project: Vision-Edge Pilot). Please let us know what you need from us — we can send the pilot usage CSV or sign any form required.

Thanks,

Thanks for the ping — read the note and the attached statement. Proposed path:

1) Issue a proforma credit memo for $14,800 referencing deal RDW-2026-0452 and the pilot agreement (Vision-Edge Pilot). Mark the memo as "Promotional top-up: pilot" in the description so Aperture's AP can match it.

2) Apply an invoice offset on the next billing cycle (March run). We will post the credit memo to the AR subledger and then net it against the March invoice at collection so their payable net is $0 for the overage portion.

3) GLA / accounting treatment: post credit to GLA 4102 (Promotional Allowances) and a contra entry to 1209 (Customer Credits Payable). That will keep revenue recognition unaffected for the period (this was our treatment for similar pilot credits in 2026).

4) Approvals: any single credit > $50k needs VP sign-off; this one is below that threshold so manager approval is fine. Please confirm manager approver (Marcus — can you sign off?) and confirm you want us to route to Billing to queue for March.

5) Deliverables: I'll attach a draft credit memo (draft_credit_memo_aperture_v1.pdf) for review. If Customer prefers an invoice offset, we'll include a short note on the credit memo with the matching invoice number and HubSpot opp id.

Notes: If Aperture insists on a refund instead of offset, we need CFO approval and a separate workflow.

Neha Kapoor
Revenue Operations Manager, Redwood Inference

Attachments: draft_credit_memo_aperture_v1.pdf, aperture_hsopp_452_link.txt

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>

Agree with Neha's proposed approach. A couple of operational checks before we proceed:

- Confirm statement matching: ask Aperture to confirm the usage CSV for the pilot slice (start/end timestamps). I noted they attached aperture_statement_feb.pdf but we should get the usage export for reconciliation.
- HubSpot: I'll update the opp RDW-2026-0452 with the credit memo number once issued. Please include the HubSpot link in the memo notes (see link in thread).
- DocuSign: If they need a signed amendment confirming the promotional top-up, route the credit memo via DocuSign. Link provided if needed.
- Billing timing: We can apply an offset on the March billing run only if the credit memo is issued and posted to AR by EOD 24 Feb. Please confirm that timeline.

If Marcus can confirm manager approval and ask Aperture for the usage CSV today, we'll queue the memo and post before the cutoff.

Laura Bennett
Director, Billing & Collections, Redwood Inference
